full.description: This is a microscopic histopathological image of prostate tissue. The section displays epithelial hyperplasia with characteristic infolding of the glandular epithelium into the lumen. The cells exhibit benign features without significant atypia. The overall appearance is consistent with benign prostatic hyperplasia.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of prostate tissue. It shows a prostatic acinus lined by epithelial cells undergoing apoptosis following an orchiectomy. The glandular epithelium exhibits characteristic apoptotic bodies and regressive changes. This demonstrates cellular involution within the prostate gland due to androgen deprivation.
